themes.title: Superhero HQ
themes.slogan: Whose app will save the day?
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner in bold comic-book style with halftone dots and thick ink outlines. Left: a team of original caped heroes striking poses on a city rooftop. Center: explosive comic lettering reading "Builder Day: Superhero HQ". Right: a spotlight projecting a large speech-bubble signal onto the clouds that reads "Whose app will save the day?". Must include POW and ZAP starbursts, a comic-panel border, a skyline at night, and flowing capes. Palette of primary red, blue, and yellow. Only original heroes, no existing characters or emblems.

themes.title: Summer Camp
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of a lakeside summer camp at dusk. Left: rustic log cabins with carved wooden cabin signs, a canoe rack on the dock, and a flagpole. Center: hand-carved wood-plank lettering reading "Builder Day: Summer Camp". Right: a crackling campfire with campers roasting marshmallows, beside a wooden trail sign that reads "S'more apps, please.". Must include braided lanyards, a camp bugle, tall pine trees, fireflies, a canoe gliding on the lake, and a starry sky. Palette of forest green, campfire orange, and lake blue.

themes.title: Game Day
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of a packed stadium at night under bright floodlights. Center: bold varsity-block lettering reading "Builder Day: Game Day". Right side: a giant stadium scoreboard whose screen reads "May the best app win.". Must include foam fingers, waving pennants, a striped field with yard lines, confetti, and fans in generic jerseys. Palette of navy, red, and white. No real league or team logos.

themes.title: Mission Control
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of a 1960s-style space mission control room. Left: rows of glowing consoles with engineers in headsets and short-sleeve shirts. Center: bold retro-futurist lettering reading "Builder Day: Mission Control". Right: a large wall display showing a rocket lifting off, with a digital countdown clock beneath it that reads "Houston, we have an app.". Must include a mission trajectory map on a big screen, blinking indicator lights, clipboards, and a crescent moon. Palette of deep navy, amber, and white. No NASA or agency logos.

themes.title: Wild West
themes.slogan: Wanted: the best app in the West.
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of a frontier town main street at sunset. Left: swinging saloon doors, a hitching post, and a horse. Center: weathered wood-type lettering reading "Builder Day: Wild West". Right: a torn wanted poster nailed to a wooden wall that reads "WANTED: The best app in the West". Must include a rolling tumbleweed, saguaro cacti, a sheriff's tin star badge, a cowboy hat, and dusty golden light. Palette of burnt orange, rust, and sepia.

themes.title: Pirates
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of a pirate galleon on a stormy teal sea. Left: the ship with billowing sails, cannon smoke, and a skull-and-crossbones flag. Center: weathered gold nautical lettering reading "Builder Day: Pirates". Right: an unrolled parchment treasure map with a dotted path to a big red X, labeled "X marks the app". Must include an open treasure chest spilling gold coins, a parrot, a compass, a spyglass, and a tricorn hat. Palette of deep teal, gold, and weathered brown.

themes.title: Pit Stop
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner, motorsport style. Left third: a pit crew in patch-covered jumpsuits mid tire change on a sleek open-wheel race car. Center: bold italic racing lettering reading "Builder Day: Pit Stop". Right third: a trackside pit board sign that reads "May the best app win.". Must include a waving black-and-white checkered flag, stacked tires, a row of red starting lights, pit lane markings, and motion-blur speed streaks. Palette of red, black, white, and yellow. No real team logos or sponsors.

themes.title: Derby Day
themes.slogan: On your marks, get set, code!
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of a historic horse racetrack on race day. Left: thoroughbreds thundering down the dirt track with jockeys in bright silks. Center: ornate vintage lettering reading "Builder Day: Derby Day". Right: a grand tote board that reads "On your marks, get set, code!". Must include spectators in extravagant hats, a garland of red roses, silver julep cups, the grandstand with twin spires, and a finish-line post. Palette of rose red, emerald, and ivory. No real track logos.

themes.title: Level Up
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of a colorful side-scrolling platformer game world. Left: an original pixel-art hero leaping between floating blocks, collecting spinning coins. Center: glowing game-HUD lettering reading "Builder Day: Level Up" with a burst of stars. Right: an in-game dialog box with pixel borders that reads "Player 1, ready to build?". Must include a HUD bar across the top with health hearts, an XP bar, and a coin counter, plus a treasure chest, a boss castle in the distance, and a LEVEL UP! burst. Bright 16-bit palette. Only original characters and blocks, no existing game imagery.

themes.title: Road Trip
themes.banner_prompt: Ultra-wide 1920 x 324 px web banner of an open desert highway stretching to the horizon at sunset. Left: a wood-paneled vintage station wagon with luggage strapped to the roof. Center: retro postcard-style lettering reading "Builder Day: Road Trip". Right: a green highway sign that reads "Next stop: the best app.", beside a neon motel sign with a VACANCY light. Must include a giant roadside attraction, a folded paper map, a vintage gas pump, telephone poles, and mesas in the distance. Palette of sunset orange, turquoise, and desert tan.
